integrity: All computation described is reproducible with the embedded standalone source and has no external dependencies. No independent scientific audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Irrational slopes, binary Sturmian factor languages, and iterates k>=2 only; no extension to arbitrary aperiodic words, multi-letter alphabets, or rational slopes outside the factor-period regime. Proof is mathematical; finite tests are regression checks, not infinite certificates.
title: All-iterate tortoise complexity of Sturmian words
